concepts.description: Formal Tolkāppiyam rules that define or classify letters, dependent signs, phonological categories, articulation, or closely related letter-system structure. This is grammatical concept evidence, not a historical technology claim.

Formal Tolkāppiyam evidence that places a grammatical or phonological phenomenon specifically in an இசை/music context. It does not by itself establish a historical performance event, performer, instrument, or social practice.

Formal Tolkāppiyam reference to another textual, scholarly, or disciplinary tradition. Exact source wording is retained; the concept does not resolve the reference to a particular external work unless the source itself establishes that identity.

Formal Tolkāppiyam rules that classify word completeness, one-letter or multi-letter word structure, தொடர்மொழி, or comparable structural classes of words. This is grammatical structural evidence, not a historical technology or social-classification claim.

concepts.label_ta: செய்யுள் / பாடல் வடிவச் சூழல் இலக்கணச் சான்று
concepts.description: Formal Tolkāppiyam evidence that conditions a grammatical rule by an explicitly stated செய்யுள் or poetic/textual-form context. It does not by itself classify Akam/Puram, identify an external work, or establish a historical performance event.

Formal Tolkāppiyam treatment of bodily articulation sites and breath pathways used to explain speech-sound production. This is grammatical articulatory-anatomy evidence, not a diagnosis, medical claim, or general physiology reconstruction.

Formal Tolkāppiyam rules that classify grammatical word classes, case markers, சாரியை, inflectional or related morphological forms. This is grammatical-system evidence, not a historical social classification.

Formal Tolkāppiyam rules governing sound/form changes at word, morpheme, case-marker or சாரியை boundaries, including புணர்ச்சி, addition, loss and alternation. This is grammatical evidence, not a historical speech-event claim.

Formal Tolkāppiyam treatment of அளவு, நிறை, எண் and related measure/quantity expressions as grammatical classes or form-governing categories. It does not by itself reconstruct a historical economic system, market, or standardized metrology.

Formal Tolkāppiyam rules governing syntactic combination, agreement, case relations, ordering, completion, and dependencies among பெயர், வினை and related grammatical classes. This is grammatical-system evidence, not a historical social relationship claim.

Formal Tolkāppiyam rules that state, distinguish, or constrain lexical meanings and polysemy within the grammatical analysis. Mentioned meanings remain source-contextual and do not automatically become historical lived-life claims.

Formal Tolkāppiyam rules governing question and answer, speaker reference, usage, register, deixis, implication, and discourse-conditioned forms. This is grammatical evidence, not a reconstruction of a historical conversation or hierarchy.
